messages:
Priya: Quick sync — planning Q2 console/observability slice. Need to lock scope: dashboards, lightweight trace hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. Customers: Acme (per-route cost), Nova (error spike alerts). Proposed prioritization: 1) dashboard templates, 2) trace hook pilot w/ adaptive sampling, 3) error analytics baseline. Thoughts? :calendar:
Marco: +1 on templates. Can we reuse existing widget lib? If yes, ETA 2 sprints for 4 templates.
Samira: Trace hooks need sampling knobs and a way to tag customer requests. Adaptive sampling prototype needs ~1 sprint + infra support.
Jun: Cost breakdown: per-route cost requires token attribution from runtime and merging with billing exports. Blocker: billing tagging work not started.
Alex: For Nova alerts — do we want threshold-based alerts or anomaly detection? Anomaly requires baselines and more data.
Priya: MVP decision: threshold alerts for launch, anomaly detection as opt-in alpha. Acceptance criteria (MVP): dashboard templates (latency p50/p95, throughput, cost widget, error rate), trace hook SDK with `sampling=0.05` toggle and header support, cost per-route export (CSV), alerting rule docs + example.
Taylor: Rollout plan: canary to subset of tenants (reserved/dedicated) then gradual. Ops requirement: add <10% p95 latency overhead budget.
Marco: Dev note: will add `X-Trace-Owner` header propagation to runtime. Putting a ticket in eng-runtime backlog.
Samira: Also need `sample_by_customer=true` flag so customers can opt-in filtered sampling.
Priya: Customer asks: Acme says they'll pay for per-route iff overhead <5%; Nova wants email + Slack alerts. @Taylor can you confirm Slack webhook flow and auth model?
Taylor: Slack webhook flow OK. On auth — we'll use per-tenant webhook tokens stored in KMS. Quick question: how granular should cost buckets be? route only? route+model?
Jun: Recommend route+model for accurate unit economics. More compute but we can batch attribution every 5m to reduce overhead.
Alex: ops-bot: deploy-plan queued for feature branch `feature/console-observe-q2`. :robot_face:
Priya: Next steps: Marco/Samira/Jun assemble implementation plan + risk table by EOD Wed. Triage meeting Thu 10:00am. If there are blocking deps (billing tagging, runtime header support), call them out in the plan.
Taylor: I'll stub the canary rollout doc and Slack/email alert templates today.
Marco: Noted. I'll also add effort estimate for widget refactor (possible reuse of existing components).
Samira: I'll prototype adaptive sampler with a tiny LRU cache for recent traces to pick hot paths.
Jun: I'll scope the billing merge task and coordinate with finance/billing eng.
Priya: Thanks — goal is a shipable MVP for limited customers by end of Q2. Keep notes in the roadmap epic and link back here for visibility. :rocket:
